claims.claim: NHS 111 online is free to use.
claims.quote: NHS 111 Online is free to use for the public
claims.note: The NHS Digital article explicitly describes the service as free to the public.

claims.claim: Anyone in England can use NHS 111 online for symptoms.
claims.quote: NHS 111 online is for people in England aged 5 and over who need urgent health care advice but it’s not a life-threatening situation.
claims.note: Symptom triage is for people aged five or over, although an emergency prescription can be requested for someone of any age.

claims.claim: NHS 111 online is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
claims.quote: operational and supported 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.
claims.note: The stated round-the-year operation includes every day of the week.

claims.claim: Use NHS 111 online when you need medical help fast but the situation is not life-threatening.
claims.quote: NHS 111 online is for people in England aged 5 and over who need urgent health care advice but it’s not a life-threatening situation.
claims.note: The page gives this urgent, non-life-threatening use case for people aged five or over.

claims.quote: It helps people with an urgent medical need to get assessed and directed to the right care
claims.note: The service assesses urgent medical needs and directs users to care.

claims.claim: The service may advise you to go to A&E.
claims.quote: call 999 or go to A&E in an emergency
claims.note: A&E is listed as a possible outcome.

claims.claim: The service may advise you to see a GP urgently.
claims.quote: see an evening and weekend GP (out-of-hours GP)
claims.note: The urgent care outcomes include an evening or weekend GP.

claims.claim: The service may advise you to visit a pharmacy.
claims.quote: see a pharmacist for help with a minor illness
claims.note: A pharmacist is listed as a possible outcome.

claims.claim: The service may advise you to treat yourself at home.
claims.quote: If you're told it’s safe to look after yourself, we'll tell you how to do that at home.
claims.note: The service may give self-care advice for home.
